_doc: The Samurai's attacks and skills (GPT's REBORN direction v1.1, M3/M4 reviews and the v1.2 decisions). Times in seconds, distances in metres. kind: melee (a blade; its path baked) | projectile (thrown at its release event: speed, radius, range, height and ahead of his feet; capture: the hold a hit gives a target that can be captured) | pull (Chain Pull: the endpoint ahead of him; the drag takes the target's distance / speed, within min..max). button: the input that starts it; cond = a Legacy Chain opportunity (graph). aim_range: the aim assist's reach through startup. graph: the Legacy Chain's edges — on an authoritative event, unlock an ability against the event's target for window s; rank: GPT's priority (1 first); requires: the target state it needs; cancel: the action whose recovery it may cut, from that fraction on. anim / anim_from / anim_speed: the move, where to start it and how fast to play it so its swing fills the active window. reaction: how long the target reels; knockback: how far it is pushed; lunge: his step into the cut. The blade's path through each active window is baked into samurai_blades.json by tools/bake_blades.mjs (re-run it after changing any timing or move here).
